page_topic_one_liner: AI product naming framework — four-tier architecture (company, product, model, feature), six strategies, sound symbolism, and trademark pre-screening
differentiator_vs_generic: This is systematic AI brand naming methodology, NOT generic branding inspiration, NOT domain selection alone. Hero must be a four-tier naming pyramid with phoneme waveform and trademark check motif — the layered naming architecture visual.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): Four-tier naming pyramid — Company (top), Product, Model, Feature (base) as stacked blocks with blur example names per tier and alignify-navy accent border on Product tier
Sound symbolism waveform strip beneath pyramid — phoneme curve with v/i/plosive blur markers
Secondary: trademark pre-screen checklist with 3 rows (globe icon, TM symbol blur, green/red status dots)
anti_patterns: Random word cloud without tier structure
Domain registrar screenshot as sole visual
Generic logo design mockup unrelated to naming framework
